program_name: Graduation of the Ultra Poor Pilot
intervention_description: Graduation-style intervention with asset transfers, coaching, and skills training for 4Ps conditional cash transfer recipients

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: 4Ps conditional cash transfer program provides consumption support
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Productive asset transfers were a key program component
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Training in business planning and asset management was provided
graduation_components_rationale.savings: Program facilitated savings and microfinance institution connections
graduation_components_rationale.coaching: Individual and group coaching sessions were core program elements
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: No explicit social empowerment activities described

outcomes.outcome_description: Monthly household consumption per capita in Philippine pesos
outcomes.literal_text: 311-342 pesos greater than control group average of 3,992 pesos

outcomes.outcome_description: Composite food security index in standard deviations
outcomes.literal_text: 0.20-0.28 standard deviations higher than control households

outcomes.outcome_description: Value of productive assets in Philippine pesos
outcomes.literal_text: 1,954-4,484 pesos more than control households' average of 10,546 pesos

outcomes.outcome_description: Monthly household income in Philippine pesos
outcomes.literal_text: No statistically significant change in monthly income

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage point increase in likelihood of having savings
outcomes.literal_text: 6-15 percentage points more likely to have savings

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage point increase in group membership
outcomes.literal_text: 4-6 percentage points increase in group membership for T1 and T3 arms
